_about: Names for the basins the run finds. Basins are found by clustering how communities differ from the rest of their world in the same run (what a whole run shares is the theory's institutional layer, reported per scenario). A cluster takes the name whose hint words best match the practices it holds more of than its world. The first seven are the spec's stylised basins (Table 'Stylised basins'); the rest are additions for the extended catalogue. 'tags' are practice hint words with weights. 'attends', 'ignores' and 'capture' are the spec's reading, shown as expectations to compare with what the run found.

basins.name: Grain tribute
basins.ignores: autonomy of labourers; diet breadth and health; soil salt

basins.name: Mobile pastoral confederacy
basins.attends: herd size, honour, alliances, freedom of movement
basins.ignores: pasture condition as herds grow; captives and clients

basins.name: Maritime exchange, extractive
basins.ignores: source societies; crews and bound labour; long-run supply

basins.name: Seasonal ceremonial aggregation
basins.attends: ritual knowledge, alliance, timing, equality norms
basins.ignores: buffering against multi-year failure; the uninitiated

basins.name: Fossil-industrial
basins.attends: throughput, measured output, lifespan, formal knowledge
basins.ignores: atmospheric and biotic sinks; free time; supply peripheries; variety of ways of living
basins.capture: debt, wage dependence, distant displacement, organised violence

basins.name: Agro-ecological commons
basins.attends: soil, diet breadth, seed, shared rules
basins.ignores: reach; capacity for large mobilisation; outsiders' claims
basins.capture: exclusion of outsiders; elders' control of seed and land

basins.name: Mercantile credit
basins.ignores: debtors; the countryside that feeds the towns

basins.name: Forager commons
basins.capture: little from outside; elders and initiates within

basins.name: Metal and fuel workings
basins.ignores: the land around the workings; the health of those who work them
basins.capture: debt and tribute in labour; displacement around the pits

basins.name: Forest foraging and crafts
basins.ignores: storage against bad years; large-scale coordination
